name: Sotai
title: Descendant of Solomon's Servants
summary: Sotai is mentioned as the ancestor of one of the families among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. He is a lesser-known biblical figure, but his family is documented among those who returned with Zerubbabel. His descendants were counted among the temple servants in the rebuilt Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Descendants of Solomon's Servants in Ezra
keyEvents.description: Sotai's descendants are mentioned among those who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile, in the list of the descendants of Solomon's servants.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Descendants of Solomon's Servants in Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: In a parallel list in the book of Nehemiah, Sotai's descendants are again mentioned among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Sotai's family was part of the large group that returned from the Babylonian exile under the leadership of Zerubbabel and Joshua to rebuild the temple and Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Role of Solomon's Servants in Temple Work
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Solomon's servants, including Sotai's family, were counted together with the temple servants (the Nethinim) and had specific duties related to the operation of the temple.
